name: Bench Press
description: Lie on a flat bench and press a barbell upward from chest height.

name: Push-up
description: Lower and raise your body using your arms while in a plank position.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Press dumbbells upward on an inclined bench to target the upper chest.

name: Cable Fly
description: Pull cable handles in an arc motion to isolate the chest muscles.

name: Pull-up
description: Hang from a bar and pull yourself up until your chin clears it.

name: Barbell Row
description: Hinge at the hips and row a barbell toward your lower chest.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Pull a cable bar down to your upper chest while seated at a machine.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Pull a cable handle toward your torso while seated with legs extended.

name: Squat
description: Lower your body by bending at the knees and hips with a barbell on your back.

name: Deadlift
description: Lift a barbell from the floor to a standing position by extending hips and knees.

name: Leg Press
description: Push a weighted platform away from you while seated on a leg press machine.

name: Lunges
description: Step forward and lower your rear knee toward the ground, then return.

name: Overhead Press
description: Press a barbell overhead from shoulder height to full arm extension.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides until arms are parallel with the floor.

name: Face Pull
description: Pull a rope attachment toward your face to target the rear deltoids.

name: Bicep Curl
description: Curl a barbell or dumbbells upward by flexing the elbow.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Push a cable bar downward by extending the elbow to work the triceps.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Curl dumbbells with a neutral (hammer) grip to target the brachialis.

name: Plank
description: Hold a push-up position with a straight body to engage the core.

name: Crunches
description: Curl your upper body toward your knees while lying on your back.
